style: High-detail modern pixel art video game sprite, hi-bit style in the spirit of Blasphemous, SNK's The Last Blade and Octopath Traveler character sprites: bold clean dark ink outline, vivid ukiyo-e inspired palette of vermilion red, gold and ivory with polished steel, crisp cel-shaded highlights and hue-shifted shadows, rich detail in armour, cloth folds and ornament. Crisp square pixels on a consistent grid, no blur, no soft gradients, no glow or magic effects drawn. Match the attached reference image exactly in art style, pixel size, palette and level of detail.
key: Plain flat solid pure green (#00FF00) background, no ground, no cast shadow, no text, no border, no UI.
logo: Pixel art video game title logo reading exactly KINGFALL in one line: bold ornate medieval capital letters in gleaming gold with vermilion red inner shading and a dark ink outline, a small crown resting on top of the letter K, a greatsword running horizontally behind the word, a few cherry blossom petals drifting across it. High-detail modern pixel art in the spirit of SNK fighting game logos, crisp square pixels, no blur. Wide landscape image, the logo centred and filling most of the width. Plain flat solid pure green (#00FF00) background, no other text, no border.
single: One character only, facing right, full body, side-on three-quarter view, centred, filling about 85 percent of the image height, feet near the bottom edge, square image.
sheetHead: Pixel art fighting game sprite sheet of the SAME character as the attached reference, redrawn at a smaller, simpler level of detail (cleaner shapes, fewer tiny ornaments, bold readable silhouette, about half the pixel resolution) so it animates well. Wide landscape image, 8 animation frames in a strict grid of 4 columns by 2 rows, read left to right then top to bottom, with clear empty green space between neighbouring frames so no two frames touch.
sheetTail: Every frame shows the whole character facing right at exactly the same scale, with the feet on the same baseline in each cell and the body centred in its cell, so the frames line up when played in sequence. Consistent colours and design across all frames, animated in the fluid style of SNK and Capcom 2D fighting games. Bold dark ink outline, vivid vermilion, gold, ivory and steel palette, crisp square pixels, no blur. Plain flat solid pure green (#00FF00) background, no grid lines, no frame numbers, no text, no ground, no shadows.
idlehit: TOP ROW, frames 1 to 4: a subtle idle breathing loop in the ready stance of the reference: chest rising and falling, cloth swaying slightly, weapon bobbing gently; the pose barely changes between these four frames. BOTTOM ROW, frames 5 to 8: a hit reaction: frame 5 flinching as a heavy blow lands, head snapping back; frame 6 staggering backwards off balance; frame 7 the furthest point of the recoil, nearly falling; frame 8 catching balance and starting to recover.
bgBoard: Detailed modern pixel art game background in the HD-2D spirit of Octopath Traveler and Triangle Strategy, seen from a high three-quarter top-down angle like a tactics RPG battle map. The centre of the image is a large EMPTY flat paved plaza filling the middle 60 percent of the picture, kept completely clear because a game board will be drawn there. Scenery only frames the left, right and top edges; the top fifth shows distant scenery and sky. Rich lighting with warm lights against cool shadows. No characters, no chess board, no text, no UI, no border. Wide 16:9 landscape image.
bgBattle: Detailed modern pixel art fighting game stage background, side-on view in the spirit of SNK's The Last Blade and Samurai Shodown stages, with painterly ukiyo-e influence. A flat ground runs across the bottom quarter of the image for fighters to stand on, the middle is open, layered scenery recedes into the distance. Rich lighting with warm lights against cool shadows. No characters, no text, no UI, no border. Wide 16:9 landscape image.
fx: Pixel art fighting game visual effect sprite sheet, in the spirit of SNK The Last Blade and Blasphemous hit effects. Wide landscape image, 8 animation frames in a strict grid of 4 columns by 2 rows, read left to right then top to bottom, each frame centred in its own cell with empty black space between frames so no two frames touch. Crisp chunky square pixels on a consistent grid, hard edges, flat colours, no blur, no soft glow, no gradients, no characters, no text, no grid lines, no frame numbers. Plain flat pure black (#000000) background. Limited palette of pure white, pale yellow, gold and vermilion orange only.
fxDust: Pixel art fighting game visual effect sprite sheet, in the spirit of SNK The Last Blade and Blasphemous hit effects. Wide landscape image, 8 animation frames in a strict grid of 4 columns by 2 rows, read left to right then top to bottom, each frame centred in its own cell with empty black space between frames so no two frames touch. Crisp chunky square pixels on a consistent grid, hard edges, flat colours, no blur, no soft glow, no gradients, no characters, no text, no grid lines, no frame numbers. Plain flat pure black (#000000) background. Limited palette of exactly four flat greys only: near white, light grey, mid grey and dark grey. No colour.

jobs.text: A hulking STONE GOLEM built from a castle tower (the chess rook): its torso and head are one round crenellated ivory-stone castle tower with battlements on top like a crown, glowing golden arrow-slit eyes, a portcullis gate for a mouth, huge stone-block arms with massive fists, thick stone legs, vermilion banners with gold sun emblems hanging from it and a small red pennant flag on top. Heavy ready fighting stance.

A European medieval mounted KNIGHT (the chess knight): a knight in full polished plate armour with a red feather plume, riding a powerful white warhorse wearing a vermilion-and-gold caparison and a steel chanfron, holding a long lance upright with a red pennant and a heater shield bearing a gold sun. The horse stands proud, one foreleg raised. The whole horse and rider must fit in the image.

A European medieval BISHOP: an elderly white-bearded bishop in a tall ivory-and-gold mitre, ornate ivory vestments with a vermilion stole and gold embroidery, holding a tall golden crozier staff with a crystal set in its crook, standing in a calm, ready stance.

A European medieval warrior QUEEN: elegant and fierce, a golden crown with tall points, long flowing golden hair, a vermilion-and-gold gown over an armoured steel bodice, an ermine-trimmed mantle, holding a slender jewelled longsword in a poised fencing stance.

The frames are one continuous magical transformation from a chess piece into the king. Frame 1: a lifeless ornate chess KING piece standing alone, a classic Staunton king silhouette with a cross on top, carved from ivory marble with vermilion bands and gold trim, about two thirds as tall as the final character. Frame 2: the chess piece cracking, golden light shining from the seams. Frames 3 to 6: the piece unfolding and reshaping step by step, growing taller: the crown and bearded head emerging from the top, the body splitting into armoured arms and legs, the cape unfurling, the greatsword forming in his hands. Frame 7: almost fully formed, settling into stance. Frame 8: the king in the ready stance of the reference.
@idlehit

The frames are one looping 8-frame run cycle seen in place: the king charging to the right with powerful strides, greatsword held low at his side, cape streaming behind, each frame a different phase of the stride so the cycle loops smoothly.

The frames are one smooth, continuous spear attack: frame 1 ready stance; frame 2 anticipation, crouching and drawing the spear back; frame 3 fully coiled, spear pulled far back; frame 4 exploding forward with a motion smear on the spear tip; frame 5 full-extension lunging thrust, spear horizontal pointing right, front knee bent; frame 6 holding the impact; frame 7 pulling the spear back; frame 8 recovering toward ready stance.

The frames are one continuous magical transformation from a chess piece into the soldier. Frame 1: a lifeless ornate chess PAWN piece standing alone, a classic Staunton pawn silhouette with a round ball top, carved from ivory marble with a vermilion band and gold trim, about two thirds as tall as the final character. Frame 2: the chess piece cracking, golden light shining from the seams. Frames 3 to 6: the piece unfolding and reshaping step by step, growing taller: the ball top becoming the round kettle helmet and head, arms and legs splitting out, the shield and spear forming. Frame 7: almost fully formed, settling into stance. Frame 8: the soldier in the ready stance of the reference.
@idlehit

The frames are one looping 8-frame run cycle seen in place: the soldier sprinting to the right, leaning forward, spear levelled, shield tucked in, each frame a different phase of the stride so the cycle loops smoothly.

The frames are one smooth, continuous two-fisted smash attack: frame 1 ready stance; frame 2 anticipation, sinking down, arms drawing back; frame 3 both massive fists raised high overhead; frame 4 the fists starting down with motion smears; frame 5 both fists crashing down in front of it at ground level, body bent forward; frame 6 holding the impact, crouched over its fists; frame 7 rising; frame 8 recovering toward ready stance.

The frames are one continuous magical transformation from a chess piece into the golem. Frame 1: a lifeless ornate chess ROOK piece standing alone, a classic castle tower silhouette with battlements, carved from ivory marble with a vermilion band and gold trim, about two thirds as tall as the final character. Frame 2: the tower cracking, golden light shining from the seams and from two arrow slits. Frames 3 to 6: the tower rising up step by step: thick stone legs pushing out from the base, huge stone arms unfolding from the sides, the arrow-slit eyes blazing, banners unfurling. Frame 7: almost fully formed, fists clenching. Frame 8: the golem in the ready stance of the reference.
@idlehit

The frames are one looping 8-frame heavy walk cycle seen in place: the golem stomping to the right with huge lumbering strides, arms swinging, body rocking with each step, each frame a different phase of the stride so the cycle loops smoothly.

The frames are one smooth, continuous lance attack: frame 1 ready stance, horse standing; frame 2 anticipation, the horse gathering itself and the lance lowering; frame 3 the horse rearing up high on its hind legs; frame 4 plunging forward with a motion smear on the lance; frame 5 full-extension lance thrust, the horse lunging low and forward, lance horizontal pointing right; frame 6 holding the impact; frame 7 pulling back; frame 8 recovering toward ready stance. The whole horse and rider fit inside every frame.

The frames are one continuous magical transformation from a chess piece into the mounted knight. Frame 1: a lifeless ornate chess KNIGHT piece standing alone, a classic Staunton horse-head silhouette facing right, carved from ivory marble with a vermilion band and gold trim, about two thirds as tall as the final character. Frame 2: the chess piece cracking, golden light shining from the seams. Frames 3 to 6: the piece unfolding and reshaping step by step, growing larger: the carved horse head becoming a living horse's head and neck, the body and four legs pushing out, the caparison unfurling, the armoured rider and lance forming on its back. Frame 7: almost fully formed, the horse stamping. Frame 8: the mounted knight in the ready stance of the reference. The whole figure fits inside every frame.
@idlehit The whole horse and rider fit inside every frame.

The frames are one looping 8-frame full gallop cycle seen in place: the warhorse galloping to the right, legs gathering under the body and then fully extended, the knight leaning forward with the lance levelled, plume and caparison streaming back, each frame a different phase of the gallop so the cycle loops smoothly. The whole horse and rider fit inside every frame.

The frames are one smooth, continuous holy spell cast: frame 1 ready stance; frame 2 anticipation, drawing the crozier in; frame 3 the crozier raised high overhead in both hands, its crystal blazing, robes billowing upward; frame 4 swinging the staff forward with a motion smear; frame 5 the crozier thrust forward to the right, arm fully extended, robes whipping back; frame 6 holding the cast; frame 7 lowering the staff; frame 8 recovering toward ready stance.

The frames are one continuous magical transformation from a chess piece into the bishop. Frame 1: a lifeless ornate chess BISHOP piece standing alone, a classic Staunton bishop silhouette with a mitre top and diagonal slit, carved from ivory marble with a vermilion band and gold trim, about two thirds as tall as the final character. Frame 2: the chess piece cracking, golden light shining from the seams. Frames 3 to 6: the piece unfolding and reshaping step by step, growing taller: the mitre top becoming the bishop's mitre and bearded head, the body flowing out into robes, arms emerging, the crozier forming in his hand. Frame 7: almost fully formed, settling. Frame 8: the bishop in the ready stance of the reference.
@idlehit

The frames are one looping 8-frame walk cycle seen in place: the bishop striding briskly to the right, robes swishing around his feet, crozier planted forward with each step, each frame a different phase of the stride so the cycle loops smoothly.

The frames are one smooth, continuous sword combo: frame 1 ready stance; frame 2 anticipation, sword drawn back; frame 3 a lightning lunge thrust to the right with a motion smear on the blade; frame 4 full-extension thrust, front knee bent, hair and gown streaming; frame 5 spinning with the gown flaring; frame 6 a wide horizontal slash with a crescent motion smear; frame 7 follow-through, sword swept out behind her; frame 8 recovering toward ready stance.

The frames are one continuous magical transformation from a chess piece into the queen. Frame 1: a lifeless ornate chess QUEEN piece standing alone, a classic Staunton queen silhouette with a pointed coronet, carved from ivory marble with a vermilion band and gold trim, about two thirds as tall as the final character. Frame 2: the chess piece cracking, golden light shining from the seams. Frames 3 to 6: the piece unfolding and reshaping step by step, growing taller: the coronet becoming her crown, golden hair spilling out, the body flowing out into the gown, arms emerging, the sword forming in her hand. Frame 7: almost fully formed, hair settling. Frame 8: the queen in the ready stance of the reference.
@idlehit

The frames are one looping 8-frame run cycle seen in place: the queen dashing to the right in a swift, graceful low run, sword held out to the side, gown and long hair streaming behind, each frame a different phase of the stride so the cycle loops smoothly.

Scene: a European medieval castle courtyard in spring morning light. Cherry blossom trees in full bloom at the left and right edges, castle walls with round towers and vermilion banners along the top, stone lanterns, a small koi pond in one corner, pink petals scattered over pale flagstones, a ukiyo-e sky with stylised clouds and a red rising sun beyond the walls. Palette: sakura pink, jade green, ivory stone, vermilion, sky blue.

Scene: the top of a volcanic fortress forge at night. A black basalt platform surrounded by rivers of glowing lava, giant iron braziers, anvils and chains at the edges, dark castle battlements and a smoking volcano under a red sky along the top, glowing cracks in the rock. Palette: obsidian black, deep crimson, molten orange, gold sparks.

Scene: the ruined cloister of a gothic abbey on a frozen lake at night, under a huge pale moon and a green and violet aurora. Snow-covered stone, broken pointed arches with softly glowing stained glass, frosted pine trees at the edges, ice-blue flagstones in the centre. Palette: deep navy, ice blue, teal, violet, warm candle gold accents.

Scene: the top of a medieval sea fortress on a rocky headland, in a gale at dusk. A broad rain-slick flagstone platform ringed by low crenellated sea walls, huge waves drawn like Hokusai's Great Wave bursting into white foam over the walls at the left and right edges, iron storm lanterns glowing amber on posts, coiled ropes, a great anchor and a bronze bell at the edges, torn teal banners snapping in the wind. Along the top a lighthouse keep with a warm glowing lantern room, a heaving dark sea with a distant sailing ship, and heavy thunderclouds with one break of pale light. Palette: slate blue-grey, deep teal, sea green, white foam, warm amber lantern light.

Scene: a stone castle bridge and courtyard beneath huge cherry blossom trees in full bloom, a European medieval castle keep with vermilion banners and distant blue mountains behind, a large red rising sun and stylised ukiyo-e clouds in the sky, petals drifting. Palette: sakura pink, jade green, ivory stone, vermilion, sky blue.

Scene: a vast volcanic forge hall at night, lava falls and channels of molten metal, heavy chains, a gigantic dragon-skull furnace glowing from within, a smoking volcano seen through tall stone arches. The ground is dark basalt slabs lit from below. Palette: obsidian black, deep crimson, molten orange, gold sparks.

Scene: a frozen lake before a ruined gothic abbey whose rose window glows with coloured light, a gigantic pale moon and a green and violet aurora overhead, snow drifts, frosted pines, broken statues. The ground is smooth ice dusted with snow. Palette: deep navy, ice blue, teal, violet, warm candle gold accents.

Scene: the walkway on top of the sea wall of a storm-lashed medieval fortress at dusk. Behind the battlements a towering wave drawn like Hokusai's Great Wave curls with white claws of foam, a lighthouse keep with a glowing amber lantern stands to one side, torn teal banners and iron storm lanterns along the wall, a sailing ship struggling on the heaving dark sea, heavy thunderclouds with a far-off fork of lightning and slanting rain. The ground is wet stone slabs reflecting the lantern light. Palette: slate blue-grey, deep teal, sea green, white foam, warm amber lantern light.

The effect: an impact hit spark. Frame 1 a tiny bright four-point white flash. Frames 2 and 3 a large jagged starburst with a solid white core and gold spikes thrown outward. Frames 4 and 5 the core is gone, a broken ring of streaks and wedge shards flying outward. Frames 6 to 8 only a few thinning sparks and dots left, nearly nothing in the last frame.

The effect: one sword slash crescent, a wide arc sweeping from upper left to lower right, the same size and position in each cell. Frame 1 a thin short white sliver at the start of the arc. Frames 2 and 3 the full thick crescent, solid white with a gold trailing edge, sharp tapered tips. Frames 4 and 5 the crescent thins and its trailing edge breaks into ragged strips. Frames 6 to 8 only broken fragments and thin wisps of the arc left, nearly nothing in the last frame.

The effect: one fast rapier slash, a long thin elegant curved streak sweeping from lower left up to upper right, the same size and position in each cell, much thinner than a sword crescent. Frame 1 a short white needle at the start. Frames 2 and 3 the full long thin arc, white with a fine gold edge, needle-sharp tips. Frames 4 and 5 it splits into two or three parallel hair-thin strands. Frames 6 to 8 only a few dashes left, nearly nothing in the last frame.

The effect: a huge finishing-blow explosion, the same centre in every cell. Frame 1 a white four-point flash. Frames 2 and 3 a very large solid white core with a gold halo, long sharp rays shooting out in all directions and a thin circular shock ring around it. Frames 4 and 5 the core breaks open into a hollow ring of gold and orange flame tongues, the shock ring wider and thinner, long shards flying outward. Frames 6 to 8 the ring breaks into scattered embers and sparks drifting outward, nearly nothing in the last frame.

The effect: a shockwave ring spreading across flat ground, seen from the side at a low camera angle so the ring is a wide flat ellipse about three times wider than tall, the same centre in every cell. Frame 1 a small bright flat oval flash on the ground. Frames 2 to 4 a thick bright elliptical ring growing wider, white on its outer edge and gold inside, with small spikes of energy kicking up along it. Frames 5 and 6 the ring is at its widest and thin, breaking into arcs. Frames 7 and 8 only a few broken arc segments and sparks left.

The effect: a spear thrust streak, a long horizontal lance of light pointing right, on the same horizontal line in every cell and nearly as wide as the cell. Frame 1 a short white needle at the left. Frames 2 and 3 the full length lance: needle-sharp point at the right, thickest just behind the point, white core with gold edges, tapering to a thin tail at the left, with a few thin parallel speed lines above and below it. Frames 4 and 5 the lance thins and its tail breaks into dashes. Frames 6 to 8 only a few short horizontal dashes left, nearly nothing in the last frame.

The effect: magic energy gathering, the same centre in every cell. Frames 1 to 6 a small glowing orb that grows a little each frame, white core with a gold rim, while small sparks and short streaks are pulled inward toward it from all around. Frame 7 the orb at its largest with a bright ring around it. Frame 8 a brilliant four-point star flash.

The effect: a pillar of holy light crashing straight down from the top edge of each cell onto the ground near the bottom of the cell, the same position and ground height in every cell. Frame 1 a single thin white vertical line from the top edge to the ground. Frames 2 to 4 a broad straight vertical column of light with a solid white core, gold edges and thin streaks running alongside, with a wide flat bright oval flare where it meets the ground; the column touches the top edge of the cell. Frames 5 and 6 the column narrows. Frames 7 and 8 it breaks into thin vertical strands and rising sparks, nearly nothing in the last frame.

The effect: a small round puff of dust. Frame 1 a small compact cloud. Frames 2 to 4 it billows larger and rounder, made of a few overlapping lobes, lit from the upper left with the darkest grey on the lower right. Frames 5 and 6 holes open in it and it thins. Frames 7 and 8 only a few small wisps and specks left.

The effect: dust kicked up by a heavy landing, spreading low along flat ground to the left and the right from the centre, the ground line at the same height in every cell. Frame 1 a small low dust burst at the centre. Frames 2 to 4 two low rolling clouds racing outward to the left and to the right along the ground, curling up at their outer ends, lit from the upper left. Frames 5 and 6 the clouds are far apart, thinning with holes. Frames 7 and 8 only a few wisps left near the ground.
